tweets.text:
@POTUS,Mr. President, respectfully you are running out of time to charge Obama and crew.  If this doesn't happen before midterms, expect impeachment hearings that will actually work and chaos unlike we have ever seen in dc. 

If you think everybody is Slow Rolling stuff now, everything will come to a complete stop and you will be removed. 

The writing is on the wall and we need to get this done now!

Replace Pam Bondi, put Sydney Powell in her place, sumnon John Thune and make sure the blue slip procedural nonsense stops and let's get things done before midterms or everyone will suffer.  Have him summoned to the White House everyday if that's what it takes, and if he doesn't comply, start an investigation on him for campaign donation violations. 

Our country is broken and you're the only one that can fix it. We just need the right people in place to do it.
